title: Deterministic build order from dependencies
insight: LeetCode 210 Course Schedule II: Kahn's topological sort with a min-heap of ready targets
prompt: Implement Order in builds.go for our build scheduler according to README.md, including the deterministic tie-break and the three error cases. Keep the package name and exported signature, use the standard library only, and check that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass; add tests if you find them useful.
